note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled 25 May 1905: "there were four elections" (Belfast News-Letter). The members returned unopposed in Ballybot, Belleek, Camlough, Mountnorris, Mullaghglass and Poyntzpass were not found in the reports read and are not filed. Polled 25 May 1905. Nugent and Larkin were the retiring councillors. P. Rice: no party label printed in 1905. At other elections he stood as Nationalist (Forkhill, Armagh County Council, 28 May 1902, printed 'N': Armagh Guardian, 2 May 1902, p. 2 ("But Few Contests": county council nominations, with labels); members confirmed by the Lurgan Times, 7 June 1902, p. 3 ("Armagh County Council": complete list of the elected members); Forkhill, Armagh County Council, 25 May 1905, printed 'N': Armagh Guardian, 2 June 1905, p. 5 ("Council Elections: 2 Unionist Gains, 1 Nationalist"); candidates in the Armagh Guardian, 28 April 1905, p. 5 ("Nominations: County Councillors")).
